methodSections.heading: Galette (Buckwheat Crepe) Batter
steps: Combine the buckwheat flour, salt and egg. Slowly add the water while whisking. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes.

methodSections.heading: Red Pepper-Beet Hummus
steps: Place an oven rack approximately 20cm (8in) below the broiler.

Rub the red peppers with olive oil and place in a tray on the top oven rack. Broil the peppers until blistered and blackened on all sides, turning with tongs. Transfer to a bowl, cover with plastic and allow to cool.

Adjust the oven temperature to 200°C (400°F). Peel the beets, chop them into a 1cm dice, place in a small casserole dish and toss in 1 Tbsp of the olive oil, the balsamic vinegar and salt. Cover and roast for roughly 30 minutes or until they can be easily pierced with a fork.
Peel and de-seed the red peppers over a fine mesh sieve sitting in a bowl so you catch any juice that is released.
Place the pepper flesh in a food processor along with the remaining hummus ingredients and process until smooth. If the resulting hummus is too thick, add some of the red pepper juice to thin.

methodSections.heading: Pickled Red Onion
steps: Very finely slice the red onion (using a mandoline is best) and place in a heat-safe bowl.
Bring the vinegar and sugar to a boil, reduce to a simmer for 30 seconds and stir to ensure sugar is dissolved.
Pour the hot vinegar mixture over the red onion and allow to "quick-pickle" for at least 10 minutes.

methodSections.heading: Omelettes
steps: Whisk all ingredients until well combined. Smear some oil in a large non-stick frying pan and place on medium heat.

Using a ¼ Cup measure or ladle, pour the egg into the frying pan. Immediately, pick up the pan and swirl the egg around. The goal is to have a circular omelette of uniform paper-thin thickness. Cook for 30 seconds or until tiny bubbles are visible on the surface. Flip the omelette and cook for another 30 seconds. Fold in half, transfer to a plate and repeat the process to create 6 omelettes.

methodSections.heading: Cooking the Galettes
steps: Check the consistency of the batter, which should have a similar texture to cream. Adjust if necessary.
Follow the same cooking method as used with the omelettes.

methodSections.heading: Plating
steps: Add two folded (half-circle shaped) galettes to a pan and fry over a low heat.

Sprinkle with a large four finger pinch of grated Gruyere. Layer a half-circle shaped omelette on top of each and then a generous tablespoon of the red pepper-beet hummus. Evenly spread a small handful of mixed salad greens and top with some pickled red onion.
Using a heat-proof spatula and your hand, fold in thirds over on itself to enclose the filling and make a triangle shape. Repeat with the remaining galettes and omelettes.
